name: setup-manaflow-ai-codex-sidebar
description: The sidebar of a desktop coding agent app, as one applyable unit. Settings give the proportions (340 pt wide, 36 pt rows, 14 pt text), one line per chat with its age at the right, a spinner or unread dot as the status mark, and Settled folding of chats you have read. A customize view draws the rest: a New chat row, a Pinned section, chats by project or in one list, a sort by Created or Last updated, Show more and Show less, pin and archive from a row (the chat's own pin and archive, not a copy), and the thread hover card. Remove it and everything you had comes back.
